People: Edwin Austin Abbey (illustrator, Wikidata Q259538), died 1911; Edmund Spenser (other, Wikidata Q4352055), died 1599; George Wither (other, Wikidata Q5546465), died 1667; Alfred Parsons (illustrator, Wikidata Q4723267), died 1920. They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("Abbey, Edwin Austin, 1852-1911 [Illustrator]; Spenser, Edmund, 1552?-1599 [Contributor]; Wither, George, 1588-1667 [Contributor]; Parsons, Alfred, 1847-1920 [Illustrator]") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's.

Printed edition: Old songs, with drawings, London, Harper & brothers, 1889, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/oldsongswithdraw00abberich. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 93%, 85%, 91% of their four-word runs in the scan's text. The scan does not show the credit of Edmund Spenser, whom the catalog lists; the passages show the scan holds this text.
